text: Maya, thanks for being upfront about this — I appreciate it. Unfortunately I'm not able to split the payment or accept a bank transfer directly from you, as the platform's current policy requires that any instalment arrangement goes through them, and accepting payment outside the platform would void my payout protection for your stay. Your best move is to contact the platform's support team directly and ask whether an instalment plan can be set up on their end for your booking. I hope they can sort something out for you, and I'm still looking forward to having you at Harbour Studio in September.
